shortDescription: Create, update or remove a LAN.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter name or UUID in which to operate.

options.name: ipv6_cidr
options.description: For a GET request, this value is either 'null' or contains the LAN's /64 IPv6 CIDR block if this LAN is IPv6 enabled. For POST/PUT/PATCH requests, 'AUTO' will result in enabling this LAN for IPv6 and automatically assign a /64 IPv6 CIDR block to this LAN and /80 IPv6 CIDR blocks to the NICs and one /128 IPv6 address to each connected NIC. If you choose the IPv6 CIDR block for the LAN on your own, then you must provide a /64 block, which is inside the IPv6 CIDR block of the virtual datacenter and

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: pcc
options.description: The unique identifier of the Cross Connect the LAN is connected to, if any. It needs to be ensured that IP addresses of the NICs of all LANs connected to a given Cross Connect is not duplicated and belongs to the same subnet range.

options.name: public
options.description: Indicates if the LAN is connected to the internet or not.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
